<!--
How to use
- Set `data_path` above (or knit with params = list(data_path = "...")).
- Knit to PDF. All tables and figures are built here; nothing is read from
  01_code_output. Figures are written to the folder figs_update/.
- The analysis code follows the production script (Sections 0-8). Changes:
  (1) the prior-belief measure is a parameter, so every measure-specific
  table and figure is repeated for the 6-item index (main), the 3-item
  average, and the 1-item measure (Q18_5); (2) the interflex analysis
  uses the matching continuous measure and median cutoff for each measure;
  (3) the table p-value formatter is renamed fmt_pval so it does not clash
  with fmt_p used in the CI-bar figures.
- Interpretations quote numbers computed in this file. Read the wording
  again after knitting on the real data.
-->

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(ggplot2)
  library(dplyr)

  library(estimatr)
  library(broom)
  library(modelsummary)
  library(patchwork)

})

options(knitr.kable.NA = "", dplyr.summarise.inform = FALSE)

## lm_robust wrapper: pass weights = NULL explicitly (see production script)
lm_robust <- function(formula, data, ...) {
  estimatr::lm_robust(formula, data = data, weights = NULL, ...)
}

## Output helpers ---------------------------------------------------------------
## Tables and figures are written as raw LaTeX so that captions, float
## placement, and table notes are the same in every section.
FIG_DIR <- "figs_update"
dir.create(FIG_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE)
.fig_id <- 0

emit_fig <- function(p, caption, w = 10, h = 5, maxh = 0.80) {
  .fig_id <<- .fig_id + 1
  f <- file.path(FIG_DIR, sprintf("fig_%03d.pdf", .fig_id))
  suppressWarnings(ggsave(f, plot = p, width = w, height = h, bg = "white"))
  cat("\n\n```{=latex}\n\\begin{figure}[!htbp]\n\\centering\n",
      sprintf("\\includegraphics[width=\\linewidth,height=%.2f\\textheight,keepaspectratio]{%s}\n",
              maxh, f),
      "\\caption{", caption, "}\n\\end{figure}\n```\n\n", sep = "")
}

emit_tbl <- function(tex, caption, small = FALSE, fit = FALSE) {
  tex <- paste(tex, collapse = "\n")
  # drop any float wrapper written by modelsummary / tinytable
  tex <- gsub("\\\\begin\\{table\\}(\\[[^]]*\\])?", "", tex)
  tex <- gsub("\\\\end\\{table\\}", "", tex)
  tex <- gsub("\\\\centering", "", tex)
  cat("\n\n```{=latex}\n\\begin{table}[!htbp]\n\\centering\n",
      if (small) "\\footnotesize\n",
      "\\caption{", caption, "}\n",
      # long tables: typeset into a box first, then shrink it to fit the page
      # (tabularray cannot sit directly inside \\resizebox)
      if (fit) "\\begin{lrbox}{\\fitbox}\\begin{minipage}{\\linewidth}\n",
      tex,
      if (fit) "\n\\end{minipage}\\end{lrbox}\n\\usefitbox",
      "\n\\end{table}\n```\n\n", sep = "")
}

emit_md <- function(...) cat("\n\n", ..., "\n\n", sep = "")

## Try a figure or table; print a short message instead of stopping the knit
safely <- function(expr, what) {
  tryCatch(expr, error = function(e)
    emit_md("*", what, " could not be produced: ", conditionMessage(e), "*"))
}
```

```{r data, include = FALSE}
# =============================================================================
# 0. DATA LOADING, CLEANING, AND PRIOR-BELIEF MEASURES (production Section 0)
# =============================================================================
loaded_objects <- load(params$data_path)
df_original <- get(loaded_objects[1])

df <- df_original |>
  mutate(across(
    where(haven::is.labelled),
    list(num = as.numeric, lab = as_factor),
    .names = "{.col}_{.fn}"
  ))

df <- df |>
  mutate(
    male     = as.numeric(Q26 == 1),
    age      = 2025 - Q27,
    married  = as.numeric(Q81 == 2),
    edu_high = as.numeric(Q82 == 1),
    edu_univ = as.numeric(Q82 == 2),
    edu_grad = as.numeric(Q82 == 3)
  )

df$vignette                           <- NA_real_
df$vignette[df$exp_cond == "Control"] <- 0
df$vignette[df$exp_cond == "Fraud"]   <- 1
df$vignette[df$exp_cond == "Counter"] <- 2

df$type_4                                <- NA_real_
df$type_4[df$new_type == "pre_partisan"] <- 1
df$type_4[df$new_type == "pre_citizen"]  <- 2
df$type_4[df$new_type == "main"]         <- 3
df$type_4[df$new_type == "pre2"]         <- 4

df$citizen_all                          <- NA_real_
df$citizen_all[df$type_4 == 1]          <- 0
df$citizen_all[df$type_4 == 2]          <- 1
df$citizen_all[df$type_4 %in% c(3, 4)]  <- 0

## Q18 items to a common 1-4 scale (higher = stronger conspiracy belief;
## "don't know" = NA)
trust_map <- c("1" = 1, "2" = 2, "3" = 3, "6" = 4, "5" = NA)
for (y in c("Q18_1_base", "Q18_4_base", "Q18_7_base")) {
  x <- as.numeric(df[[y]])
  df[[paste0(y, "_re")]] <- unname(trust_map[as.character(x)])
}
consp_map <- c("1" = 4, "2" = 3, "3" = 2, "6" = 1, "5" = NA)
for (y in c("Q18_2_base", "Q18_5_base", "Q18_8_base")) {
  x <- as.numeric(df[[y]])
  df[[paste0(y, "_re")]] <- unname(consp_map[as.character(x)])
}

## Prior-belief measures: averages of 1 to 6 items
CONSP_ITEMS <- list(
  "1avg" = c("Q18_5"),
  "2avg" = c("Q18_2", "Q18_5"),
  "3avg" = c("Q18_2", "Q18_5", "Q18_8"),
  "4avg" = c("Q18_2", "Q18_4", "Q18_5", "Q18_8"),
  "5avg" = c("Q18_2", "Q18_4", "Q18_5", "Q18_7", "Q18_8"),
  "main" = c("Q18_1", "Q18_2", "Q18_4", "Q18_5", "Q18_7", "Q18_8")
)
CONSP_ORDER <- c("main", "1avg", "2avg", "3avg", "4avg", "5avg")

CONSP_CONT   <- sapply(CONSP_ORDER, function(k)
  if (k == "main") "conspiracy_belief" else paste0("conspiracy_belief_", k))
CONSP_HIGH   <- sub("conspiracy_belief", "conspiracy_high", CONSP_CONT)
CONSP_SUFFIX <- setNames(ifelse(CONSP_ORDER == "main", "", paste0("_", CONSP_ORDER)),
                         CONSP_ORDER)
CONSP_NOTE   <- sapply(CONSP_ORDER, function(k) {
  it <- CONSP_ITEMS[[k]]
  paste0("Prior belief: median split of the ",
         if (length(it) == 1) "single item " else paste0(length(it), "-item average of "),
         paste(sub("Q18_", "Q18\\\\_", it), collapse = ", "), ".")
})

for (k in CONSP_ORDER) {
  cols <- paste0(CONSP_ITEMS[[k]], "_base_re")
  v    <- rowMeans(df[, cols, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
  v[is.nan(v)] <- NA
  df[[CONSP_CONT[[k]]]] <- v
}

df_cit <- df |> filter(citizen_all == 1)

## Median splits on the citizen sample (1 = above the median)
CONSP_MED <- sapply(CONSP_ORDER, function(k) median(df_cit[[CONSP_CONT[[k]]]], na.rm = TRUE))
for (k in CONSP_ORDER) {
  df_cit[[CONSP_HIGH[[k]]]] <- as.integer(df_cit[[CONSP_CONT[[k]]]] > CONSP_MED[[k]])
}
med_6 <- CONSP_MED[["main"]]

## Other moderators (robustness)
med_fair <- median(df_cit$Q22_base, na.rm = TRUE)
df_cit <- df_cit |>
  mutate(
    ppp_id        = case_when(Q32_base == 2 ~ 1L, Q33_base == 2 ~ 1L, TRUE ~ 0L),
    fairness_high = as.integer(as.numeric(Q22_base) >= med_fair)
  )

## Covariate sets
X_DEMO <- c("male", "age", "married", "edu_univ", "edu_grad")
COV_SETS    <- list(nocov = NULL, cov1 = X_DEMO)
COV_LAB     <- c(nocov = "No covariates", cov1 = "Demographic controls")
COV_ROW_LAB <- c(cov1 = "Demographic controls")
rhs_cov <- function(set) {
  x <- COV_SETS[[set]]
  if (is.null(x)) "" else paste("+", paste(x, collapse = " + "))
}

## Measures reported in this document
REPORT_MODS <- c(main = "6-item index", "3avg" = "3-item average", "1avg" = "1-item measure")
```

# =============================================================================
# 1. SUMMARY STATISTICS AND COVARIATE BALANCE (production Section 1)
# =============================================================================
OUTCOME_VARS    <- c("Q119", "Q122", "Q123")
TREATMENT_VARS  <- c("treat_control", "treat_fraud", "treat_counter", "yes")
CONSPIRACY_VARS <- c("Q18_1_base_re", "Q18_4_base_re", "Q18_7_base_re",
                     "Q18_2_base_re", "Q18_5_base_re", "Q18_8_base_re")
COVARIATE_VARS  <- X_DEMO

df_cit <- df_cit |>
  mutate(
    treat_control = as.numeric(vignette == 0),
    treat_fraud   = as.numeric(vignette == 1),
    treat_counter = as.numeric(vignette == 2)
  )

VAR_LABELS <- c(
  Q119          = "Perceived election fraud",
  Q122          = "Trust in election administration",
  Q123          = "Voting intention",
  treat_control = "Control vignette",
  treat_fraud   = "Election fraud claims vignette",
  treat_counter = "Fraud claims with official rebuttal vignette",
  yes           = "Observer (selected by lottery)",
  Q18_1_base_re = "Votes are not counted accurately",
  Q18_4_base_re = "NEC does not manage elections fairly",
  Q18_7_base_re = "Procedures are not followed accurately",
  Q18_2_base_re = "Early voting is likely manipulated",
  Q18_5_base_re = "China is likely to interfere in elections",
  Q18_8_base_re = "Errors are evidence of fraud",
  male          = "Male",
  age           = "Age",
  married       = "Married",
  edu_univ      = "University education",
  edu_grad      = "Graduate education"
)
lab <- function(x) ifelse(x %in% names(VAR_LABELS), VAR_LABELS[x], x)

esc_latex <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("\\\\", "\\\\textbackslash{}", x)
  x <- gsub("([_%&#$])", "\\\\\\1", x, perl = TRUE)
  x
}
fmt_num  <- function(x, digits = 3) ifelse(is.na(x), "", sprintf(paste0("%.", digits, "f"), x))
fmt_pval <- function(p) ifelse(is.na(p), "", ifelse(p < 0.001, "<0.001", sprintf("%.3f", p)))

summary_rows <- function(data, vars, panel_label) {
  lapply(vars, function(v) {
    x <- as.numeric(data[[v]])
    data.frame(panel = panel_label, variable = lab(v),
               mean = mean(x, na.rm = TRUE), sd = sd(x, na.rm = TRUE),
               min = suppressWarnings(min(x, na.rm = TRUE)),
               max = suppressWarnings(max(x, na.rm = TRUE)),
               n = sum(!is.na(x)), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }) |> bind_rows()
}

make_sum_stat_tex <- function(d) {
  lines <- c(
    "\\begin{tblr}{colspec={X[l]rrrrr}, width=\\linewidth, cells={font=\\footnotesize}}",
    "\\toprule",
    "Variable & Mean & Std. dev. & Min. & Max. & N \\\\",
    "\\midrule")
  for (p in unique(d$panel)) {
    lines <- c(lines, paste0("\\SetCell[c=6]{l}\\textbf{", esc_latex(p), "} & & & & & \\\\"))
    dd <- d[d$panel == p, ]
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(dd))) {
      lines <- c(lines, paste0(esc_latex(dd$variable[i]), " & ", fmt_num(dd$mean[i]), " & ",
                               fmt_num(dd$sd[i]), " & ", fmt_num(dd$min[i]), " & ",
                               fmt_num(dd$max[i]), " & ", dd$n[i], " \\\\"))
    }
  }
  lines <- c(lines, "\\bottomrule", "\\end{tblr}", "", "\\vspace{0.5em}", "",
             "\\begin{minipage}{\\linewidth}", "\\footnotesize",
             paste0("\\textit{Note:} Conspiracy belief items are coded 1--4, with higher values ",
                    "indicating stronger conspiracy belief; ``don't know'' responses are coded as missing."),
             "\\end{minipage}")
  paste(lines, collapse = "\n")
}

balance_two_groups <- function(data, vars, group_var) {
  lapply(vars, function(v) {
    d  <- data |> filter(!is.na(.data[[v]]), !is.na(.data[[group_var]]))
    x1 <- d |> filter(.data[[group_var]] == 1) |> pull(.data[[v]])
    x0 <- d |> filter(.data[[group_var]] == 0) |> pull(.data[[v]])
    p  <- tryCatch(t.test(x1, x0)$p.value, error = function(e) NA_real_)
    data.frame(variable = lab(v), mean_one = mean(x1), mean_zero = mean(x0),
               diff = mean(x1) - mean(x0), p_value = p,
               n = length(x1) + length(x0), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }) |> bind_rows()
}

make_cov_bal_1_tex <- function(d) {
  lines <- c(
    "\\begin{tblr}{colspec={X[l]rrrrr}, width=\\linewidth}",
    "\\toprule",
    "Variable & Observers & Non-observers & Difference & $p$-value & N \\\\",
    "\\midrule")
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(d))) {
    lines <- c(lines, paste0(esc_latex(d$variable[i]), " & ", fmt_num(d$mean_one[i]), " & ",
                             fmt_num(d$mean_zero[i]), " & ", fmt_num(d$diff[i]), " & ",
                             fmt_pval(d$p_value[i]), " & ", d$n[i], " \\\\"))
  }
  paste(c(lines, "\\bottomrule", "\\end{tblr}"), collapse = "\n")
}

balance_three_groups <- function(data, vars, group_var = "vignette") {
  lapply(vars, function(v) {
    d <- data |> filter(!is.na(.data[[v]]), !is.na(.data[[group_var]]))
    p <- tryCatch({
      fs <- summary(lm(as.formula(paste(v, "~ factor(", group_var, ")")), data = d))$fstatistic
      pf(fs[1], fs[2], fs[3], lower.tail = FALSE)
    }, error = function(e) NA_real_)
    data.frame(variable = lab(v),
               mean_control = mean(d[[v]][d[[group_var]] == 0]),
               mean_fraud   = mean(d[[v]][d[[group_var]] == 1]),
               mean_counter = mean(d[[v]][d[[group_var]] == 2]),
               p_value = unname(p), n = nrow(d), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }) |> bind_rows()
}

make_cov_bal_2_tex <- function(d) {
  lines <- c(
    "\\begin{tblr}{colspec={X[l]rrrrr}, width=\\linewidth}",
    "\\toprule",
    "Variable & Control & Fraud & Fraud + rebuttal & $p$-value & N \\\\",
    "\\midrule")
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(d))) {
    lines <- c(lines, paste0(esc_latex(d$variable[i]), " & ", fmt_num(d$mean_control[i]), " & ",
                             fmt_num(d$mean_fraud[i]), " & ", fmt_num(d$mean_counter[i]), " & ",
                             fmt_pval(d$p_value[i]), " & ", d$n[i], " \\\\"))
  }
  paste(c(lines, "\\bottomrule", "\\end{tblr}"), collapse = "\n")
}

sum_df <- bind_rows(
  summary_rows(df_cit, OUTCOME_VARS,    "Panel A. Outcome variables"),
  summary_rows(df_cit, TREATMENT_VARS,  "Panel B. Treatment variables"),
  summary_rows(df_cit, CONSPIRACY_VARS, "Panel C. Conspiracy belief index items"),
  summary_rows(df_cit, X_DEMO,          "Panel D. Demographic controls")
)
bal_part <- balance_two_groups(df_cit, COVARIATE_VARS, "yes")
bal_vig  <- balance_three_groups(df_cit, COVARIATE_VARS, "vignette")

```{r helpers_figs_regs, include = FALSE}
# =============================================================================
# 2-6. CI-BAR FIGURES AND REGRESSION TABLES (production Sections 2-6)
# =============================================================================
fmt_p <- function(p) sprintf("p = %.3f", p)

ci_data <- function(data, var, grp) {
  data |>
    filter(!is.na(.data[[var]]), !is.na(.data[[grp]])) |>
    group_by(.data[[grp]]) |>
    summarise(mean = mean(.data[[var]]), se = sd(.data[[var]]) / sqrt(n()),
              lo = mean - 1.96 * se, hi = mean + 1.96 * se, .groups = "drop") |>
    rename(group = 1)
}

get_pvals <- function(data, var) {
  d  <- data |> filter(!is.na(vignette), !is.na(.data[[var]]))
  tp <- function(v1, v2) {
    dd <- d |> filter(vignette %in% c(v1, v2))
    tryCatch(t.test(dd[[var]] ~ dd$vignette)$p.value, error = function(e) NA_real_)
  }
  list(p_cf = tp(0, 1), p_cc = tp(0, 2), p_fc = tp(1, 2))
}

make_cibar_panel <- function(data, var, title, y_label = "Outcome", y_offset = 0) {
  pv <- get_pvals(data, var)
  ggplot(ci_data(data, var, "vignette"),
         aes(x = factor(group, levels = c(0, 1, 2),
                        labels = c("Control", "Fraud", "Fraud +\nRebuttal")), y = mean)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "#4472C4", width = 0.6) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi), width = 0.2) +
    annotate("segment", x = 1, xend = 2, y = 4.2 + y_offset, yend = 4.2 + y_offset) +
    annotate("segment", x = 1, xend = 1, y = 4.1 + y_offset, yend = 4.2 + y_offset) +
    annotate("segment", x = 2, xend = 2, y = 4.1 + y_offset, yend = 4.2 + y_offset) +
    annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = 4.35 + y_offset, label = fmt_p(pv$p_cf), size = 4) +
    annotate("segment", x = 1, xend = 3, y = 4.6 + y_offset, yend = 4.6 + y_offset) +
    annotate("segment", x = 1, xend = 1, y = 4.5 + y_offset, yend = 4.6 + y_offset) +
    annotate("segment", x = 3, xend = 3, y = 4.5 + y_offset, yend = 4.6 + y_offset) +
    annotate("text", x = 2, y = 4.75 + y_offset, label = fmt_p(pv$p_cc), size = 4) +
    annotate("segment", x = 2, xend = 3, y = 5.0 + y_offset, yend = 5.0 + y_offset) +
    annotate("segment", x = 2, xend = 2, y = 4.9 + y_offset, yend = 5.0 + y_offset) +
    annotate("segment", x = 3, xend = 3, y = 4.9 + y_offset, yend = 5.0 + y_offset) +
    annotate("text", x = 2.5, y = 5.15 + y_offset, label = fmt_p(pv$p_fc), size = 4) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = 1:5,
                       labels = c("Not at all", "Not much", "Neutral", "Somewhat", "Very much")) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(1, 5.5 + y_offset)) +
    labs(x = "Vignette", y = y_label, title = title) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold"),
          axis.title = element_text(size = 13),
          axis.text  = element_text(size = 12))
}

out_label <- function(var) switch(var,
  Q119 = "Perceived Prob of Fraud",
  Q122 = "Trust in election administration",
  Q123 = "Plan to vote")
out_caption <- function(var) switch(var,
  Q119 = "Do you think this incident could actually be a case of election fraud or a serious procedural problem?",
  Q122 = "Despite this incident, do you think the election administration process can still be trusted?",
  Q123 = "Despite this incident, do you plan to vote in the next election?")
out_short <- function(var) switch(var,
  Q119 = "perceived fraud or procedural problems (Q119)",
  Q122 = "trust in election administration (Q122)",
  Q123 = "voting intention (Q123)")

cap_annot <- function(var) plot_annotation(
  caption = str_wrap(out_caption(var), width = 80),
  theme   = theme(plot.caption = element_text(size = 17)))

## 3a. Observers vs. non-observers
cibar_by_obs <- function(var) {
  (make_cibar_panel(df_cit |> filter(yes == 1), var, "Among Observers", out_label(var)) +
     make_cibar_panel(df_cit |> filter(yes == 0), var, "Among Non-observers", out_label(var))) +
    plot_layout(axis_titles = "collect") + cap_annot(var)
}

## 3b. Observation x prior belief (4 panels), for any measure
cibar_by_belief <- function(var, mod = "main") {
  hv  <- CONSP_HIGH[[mod]]
  sub <- function(h, o) df_cit |> filter(.data[[hv]] == h, yes == o)
  off <- if (var == "Q122") 0.6 else 0
  ((make_cibar_panel(sub(1, 1), var, "High Prior Belief: Observers", out_label(var)) +
      make_cibar_panel(sub(1, 0), var, "High Prior Belief: Non-observers", out_label(var))) /
     (make_cibar_panel(sub(0, 1), var, "Low Prior Belief: Observers", out_label(var), off) +
        make_cibar_panel(sub(0, 0), var, "Low Prior Belief: Non-observers", out_label(var), off))) +
    plot_layout(axis_titles = "collect") + cap_annot(var)
}

## 4-6. Regression tables ------------------------------------------------------
COL_COV <- c("nocov", "cov1", "nocov", "cov1")
fit_4models <- function(var, data) {
  f <- function(rhs) lm_robust(as.formula(paste(var, "~", rhs)), data = data)
  setNames(list(
    f(paste("factor(vignette) + yes",         rhs_cov("nocov"))),
    f(paste("factor(vignette) + yes",         rhs_cov("cov1"))),
    f(paste("factor(vignette) * factor(yes)", rhs_cov("nocov"))),
    f(paste("factor(vignette) * factor(yes)", rhs_cov("cov1")))
  ), paste0("(", 1:4, ")"))
}

## The observer term is named "yes", "yesTRUE", "factor(yes)TRUE", or
## "factor(yes)1" depending on how `yes` is stored; all map to "Observer".
COEF_MAP_MAIN <- c(

  "factor(vignette)2"                 = "Fraud + Rebuttal",
  "yes"                               = "Observer",
  "yesTRUE"                           = "Observer",
  "factor(yes)TRUE"                   = "Observer",
  "factor(yes)1"                      = "Observer",
  "factor(vignette)1:factor(yes)TRUE" = "Fraud $\\times$ Observer",
  "factor(vignette)1:factor(yes)1"    = "Fraud $\\times$ Observer",
  "factor(vignette)2:factor(yes)TRUE" = "(Fraud + Rebuttal) $\\times$ Observer",
  "factor(vignette)2:factor(yes)1"    = "(Fraud + Rebuttal) $\\times$ Observer"
)
GOF_MAP <- list(list(raw = "r.squared", clean = "R$^2$", fmt = 3),
                list(raw = "nobs",      clean = "N",     fmt = 0))
STARS <- c("*" = 0.1, "**" = 0.05, "***" = 0.01)

make_add_rows <- function(cov_by_col, means, sds, ncoef, panel_label = NULL) {
  k   <- length(cov_by_col)
  chk <- function(set) ifelse(cov_by_col == set, "$\\checkmark$", "")
  rows <- rbind(c(COV_ROW_LAB[["cov1"]], chk("cov1")),
                c("Outcome mean",        means),
                c("Outcome std. dev.",   sds))
  n_stat <- nrow(rows); off <- 0
  if (!is.null(panel_label)) {
    rows <- rbind(c(paste0("\\SetCell[c=", k + 1, "]{l}\\textbf{", panel_label, "}"), rep("", k)),
                  rows)
    off <- 1
  }
  r <- as.data.frame(rows, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  names(r) <- c("term", paste0("(", seq_len(k), ")"))
  pos <- off + 2 * ncoef + seq_len(n_stat)
  attr(r, "position") <- if (off == 1) c(1, pos) else pos
  r
}

patch_tblr <- function(tbl, n_models, header_label = NULL, header_span = NULL,
                       col_names = NULL, stat_marker = COV_ROW_LAB[["cov1"]],
                       panel_rule = FALSE) {
  s <- paste(tbl, collapse = "\n")
  K <- n_models + 1
  hdr_pat <- paste0("& ", paste0("\\(", seq_len(n_models), "\\)", collapse = " & "), " \\\\\\\\")
  cols    <- if (is.null(col_names)) paste0("(", seq_len(n_models), ")") else col_names
  hdr_new <- paste0("& ", paste(cols, collapse = " & "), " \\\\")
  multi <- length(header_label) > 1
  if (!is.null(header_label)) {
    if (is.null(header_span)) header_span <- n_models
    cells <- unlist(mapply(function(lab, k)
      c(paste0("\\SetCell[c=", k, "]{c} ", lab), rep("", k - 1)),
      header_label, header_span, SIMPLIFY = FALSE))
    grp_row <- paste0("& ", paste(cells, collapse = " & "), " \\\\")
    if (multi) {
      starts <- 2 + cumsum(c(0, head(header_span, -1)))
      ends   <- starts + header_span - 1
      cmid   <- paste(sprintf("\\cmidrule[lr]{%d-%d}", starts, ends), collapse = " ")
      hdr_new <- paste0(grp_row, "\n", cmid, "\n", hdr_new)
    } else {
      hdr_new <- paste0(grp_row, "\n", hdr_new)
    }
  }
  stopifnot(str_detect(s, hdr_pat))
  s <- str_replace(s, hdr_pat, function(x) hdr_new)
  s <- str_replace_all(s, "hline\\{[^}]*\\}=\\{[^}]*\\}\\{[^}]*\\},?[ \t]*\n?", "")
  lines <- strsplit(s, "\n")[[1]]
  begin <- grep("\\\\begin\\{(tall)?tblr\\}", lines)[1]
  end   <- grep("\\\\end\\{(tall)?tblr\\}",   lines)[1]
  body     <- lines[(begin + 1):(end - 1)]
  rows     <- body[grepl("\\\\\\\\\\s*$", body)]
  n_rows   <- length(rows)
  n_hdr    <- if (is.null(header_label)) 1 else 2
  stat_row <- which(startsWith(trimws(rows), stat_marker))[1]
  r <- function(i, from = 1, w = "0.05em") sprintf("hline{%d}={%d-%d}{solid, black, %s},", i, from, K, w)
  hl <- c(r(1, w = "0.08em"),
          if (!is.null(header_label) && !multi) r(2, from = 2),
          r(n_hdr + 1),
          if (panel_rule) r(n_hdr + 2),
          r(stat_row),
          r(n_rows + 1, w = "0.08em"))
  str_replace(s, "colspec=\\{[^}]*\\},", function(x) paste0(x, "\n", paste(hl, collapse = "\n")))
}

make_main_latex_tbl <- function(mods, data, var, panel_label = NULL) {
  m <- as.character(round(mean(data[[var]], na.rm = TRUE), 3))
  s <- as.character(round(sd(data[[var]],   na.rm = TRUE), 3))
  tbl <- modelsummary(
    mods, coef_map = COEF_MAP_MAIN, stars = STARS, gof_map = GOF_MAP,
    add_rows = make_add_rows(COL_COV, rep(m, 4), rep(s, 4), ncoef = 5, panel_label = panel_label),
    escape = FALSE, output = "latex")
  patch_tblr(tbl, n_models = 4, header_label = out_label(var))
}

## Pooled table (production Section 4)
tbl_pooled <- function(var) make_main_latex_tbl(fit_4models(var, df_cit), df_cit, var)

## Prior-belief subgroup tables (production Section 5), for any measure
tbl_by_belief <- function(var, mod = "main") {
  hv   <- CONSP_HIGH[[mod]]
  d_hi <- df_cit |> filter(.data[[hv]] == 1)
  d_lo <- df_cit |> filter(.data[[hv]] == 0)
  paste(make_main_latex_tbl(fit_4models(var, d_hi), d_hi, var,
                            panel_label = "Panel A. Sample: High prior beliefs"),
        "\n\n\\vspace{1em}\n\n",
        make_main_latex_tbl(fit_4models(var, d_lo), d_lo, var,
                            panel_label = "Panel B. Sample: Low prior beliefs"))
}

## Three-way interaction table (production Section 6), for any measure
COEF_MAP_3WAY <- c(
  "fraud"               = "Fraud",
  "rebut"               = "Fraud + Rebuttal",
  "observer"            = "Observer",
  "high"                = "High prior belief",
  "fraud:observer"      = "Fraud $\\times$ Observer",
  "rebut:observer"      = "(Fraud + Rebuttal) $\\times$ Observer",
  "fraud:high"          = "Fraud $\\times$ High prior belief",
  "rebut:high"          = "(Fraud + Rebuttal) $\\times$ High prior belief",
  "observer:high"       = "Observer $\\times$ High prior belief",
  "fraud:observer:high" = "Fraud $\\times$ Observer $\\times$ High prior belief",
  "rebut:observer:high" = "(Fraud + Rebuttal) $\\times$ Observer $\\times$ High prior belief",
  "(Intercept)"         = "Constant"
)

tbl_threeway <- function(mod = "main") {
  d3 <- df_cit |>
    mutate(fraud = as.integer(vignette == 1), rebut = as.integer(vignette == 2),
           observer = as.integer(yes), high = .data[[CONSP_HIGH[[mod]]]]) |>
    filter(!is.na(high))
  mods_3w <- list(); means_3w <- c(); sds_3w <- c(); cov_3w <- c()
  for (VAR in c("Q119", "Q122")) {
    for (cs in names(COV_SETS)) {
      f <- as.formula(paste(VAR, "~ (fraud + rebut) * observer * high", rhs_cov(cs)))
      mods_3w[[length(mods_3w) + 1]] <- lm_robust(f, data = d3)
      means_3w <- c(means_3w, as.character(round(mean(d3[[VAR]], na.rm = TRUE), 3)))
      sds_3w   <- c(sds_3w,   as.character(round(sd(d3[[VAR]],   na.rm = TRUE), 3)))
      cov_3w   <- c(cov_3w, cs)
    }
  }
  names(mods_3w) <- paste0("(", seq_along(mods_3w), ")")
  tbl <- modelsummary(
    mods_3w, coef_map = COEF_MAP_3WAY, stars = STARS, gof_map = GOF_MAP,
    add_rows = make_add_rows(cov_3w, means_3w, sds_3w, ncoef = length(COEF_MAP_3WAY)),
    escape = FALSE, output = "latex")
  patch_tblr(tbl, n_models = 4, header_label = c(out_label("Q119"), out_label("Q122")),
             header_span = c(2, 2))
}

# =============================================================================
# 7. CELL-MEANS CONTRASTS (production Section 7)
# =============================================================================
df_cit <- df_cit |>
  mutate(
    vig   = factor(vignette, levels = 0:2, labels = c("C", "F", "R")),
    obs   = factor(as.integer(yes), levels = 0:1, labels = c("Non", "Obs")),
    cell3 = vig,
    cell6 = interaction(obs, vig, sep = "_", drop = TRUE)
  )

MODERATORS <- CONSP_HIGH
MOD_CONT   <- CONSP_CONT
MOD_NOTE   <- CONSP_NOTE

add_cells <- function(data, mod_var) {
  data |>
    mutate(cgrp   = factor(.data[[mod_var]], levels = 0:1, labels = c("Lo", "Hi")),
           cell12 = interaction(cgrp, obs, vig, sep = "_", drop = TRUE))
}

ARM_LAB <- c(C = "Control", F = "Fraud", R = "Fraud + Rebuttal")
VIG_CONTRASTS <- list(
  "Fraud vs. Control"            = c(F = 1, C = -1),
  "Fraud + Rebuttal vs. Control" = c(R = 1, C = -1),
  "Rebuttal vs. Fraud"           = c(R = 1, F = -1)
)
CN_FC <- "Fraud vs. Control"
CN_RC <- "Fraud + Rebuttal vs. Control"
CN_RF <- "Rebuttal vs. Fraud"
CONTRAST_TEX <- c("{Fraud\\\\vs.\\ Control}",
                  "{Fraud + Rebuttal\\\\vs.\\ Control}",
                  "{Rebuttal\\\\vs.\\ Fraud}")

## 7b. Prior-belief balance table
BAL_GROUPS <- list(
  list(o = "Obs", g = "Hi", lab = "Observers, high prior beliefs"),
  list(o = "Non", g = "Hi", lab = "Non-observers, high prior beliefs"),
  list(o = "Obs", g = "Lo", lab = "Observers, low prior beliefs"),
  list(o = "Non", g = "Lo", lab = "Non-observers, low prior beliefs")
)

prior_cells <- function(mod_name) {
  add_cells(df_cit, MODERATORS[[mod_name]]) |>
    mutate(prior = as.numeric(.data[[MOD_CONT[[mod_name]]]])) |>
    filter(!is.na(cgrp), !is.na(obs), !is.na(vig), !is.na(prior))
}

## Standardized difference in the continuous measure, arm a vs. Control
prior_std_diff <- function(mod_name, o, g, a = "R") {
  dg <- prior_cells(mod_name) |> filter(obs == o, cgrp == g)
  x <- dg$prior[dg$vig == a]; xc <- dg$prior[dg$vig == "C"]
  (mean(x) - mean(xc)) / sqrt((var(x) + var(xc)) / 2)
}

make_balance_prior_tex <- function(mod_name) {
  d <- prior_cells(mod_name)
  lines <- c(
    "\\begin{tblr}{colspec={lrrrrrrrr}, width=\\linewidth, cells={font=\\footnotesize}, column{1}={halign=l}, column{2-9}={halign=r}}",
    "\\toprule",
    "Article & N & Mean & Std. dev. & P25 & Median & P75 & {Std. diff.\\\\vs. Control} & {$p$-value\\\\(equal means)} \\\\",
    "\\midrule")
  for (gr in BAL_GROUPS) {
    dg <- d |> filter(obs == gr$o, cgrp == gr$g)
    p  <- tryCatch({
      fs <- summary(lm(prior ~ vig, data = dg))$fstatistic
      pf(fs[1], fs[2], fs[3], lower.tail = FALSE)
    }, error = function(e) NA_real_)
    xc <- dg$prior[dg$vig == "C"]
    lines <- c(lines, paste0("\\SetCell[c=9]{l}\\textbf{", gr$lab, "}", strrep(" &", 8), " \\\\"))
    for (a in c("C", "F", "R")) {
      x   <- dg$prior[dg$vig == a]
      sd_ <- if (a == "C") "" else fmt_num((mean(x) - mean(xc)) / sqrt((var(x) + var(xc)) / 2))
      q   <- quantile(x, c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75), names = FALSE)
      lines <- c(lines, paste0(
        ARM_LAB[[a]], " & ", length(x), " & ", fmt_num(mean(x)), " & ", fmt_num(sd(x)), " & ",
        fmt_num(q[1]), " & ", fmt_num(q[2]), " & ", fmt_num(q[3]), " & ", sd_, " & ",
        if (a == "C") fmt_pval(p) else "", " \\\\"))
    }
  }
  lines <- c(lines, "\\bottomrule", "\\end{tblr}", "", "\\vspace{0.5em}", "",
             "\\begin{minipage}{\\linewidth}", "\\footnotesize",
             paste0("\\textit{Note:} ", MOD_NOTE[[mod_name]],
                    " Statistics describe the continuous prior-belief measure (1--4, higher = ",
                    "stronger conspiracy belief) within each observation $\\times$ prior-belief ",
                    "group, by article. Std.\\ diff.: difference from the Control mean divided by ",
                    "the pooled standard deviation. $p$-value: F-test of equal means across the ",
                    "three articles within the group."),
             "\\end{minipage}")
  paste(lines, collapse = "\n")
}

## 7c. Specifications
SPECS <- list(
  "No covariates"                    = list(x = NULL,               lin = FALSE),
  "Demographic controls"             = list(x = X_DEMO,             lin = FALSE),
  "Demographic + prior belief"       = list(x = c(X_DEMO, "PRIOR"), lin = FALSE),
  "Demographic + prior belief (Lin)" = list(x = c(X_DEMO, "PRIOR"), lin = TRUE)
)
SPEC_SETS <- list(main = c("No covariates", "Demographic controls"),
                  appx = c("Demographic + prior belief", "Demographic + prior belief (Lin)"))
FE_VAR <- NULL

## 7d. Model and contrast helpers
fit_cells <- function(var, data, cellvar, x = NULL, lin = FALSE, fe = FE_VAR) {
  d <- data |> mutate(cell = .data[[cellvar]]) |> filter(!is.na(.data[[var]]), !is.na(cell))
  if (!is.null(x))  d <- d |> filter(if_all(all_of(x), ~ !is.na(.x)))
  if (!is.null(fe)) d <- d |> filter(!is.na(.data[[fe]]))
  d   <- d |> mutate(cell = droplevels(cell))
  rhs <- "0 + cell"
  if (!is.null(x)) {
    d  <- d |> mutate(across(all_of(x), ~ as.numeric(.x) - mean(as.numeric(.x)), .names = "{.col}_c"))
    xc <- paste0(x, "_c")
    if (!lin) {
      rhs <- paste(rhs, "+", paste(xc, collapse = " + "))
    } else {
      lin_terms <- character(0)
      for (cl in levels(d$cell)) {
        in_cl <- d$cell == cl
        M     <- cbind(1, as.matrix(d[in_cl, xc, drop = FALSE]))
        q     <- qr(M)
        keep  <- setdiff(q$pivot[seq_len(q$rank)], 1) - 1
        for (v in xc[keep]) {
          nm <- paste0("lin_", make.names(cl), "__", v)
          d[[nm]] <- d[[v]] * in_cl
          lin_terms <- c(lin_terms, nm)
        }
      }
      if (length(lin_terms) > 0) rhs <- paste(rhs, "+", paste(lin_terms, collapse = " + "))
    }
  }
  if (!is.null(fe)) rhs <- paste0(rhs, " + factor(", fe, ")")
  lm_robust(as.formula(paste(var, "~", rhs)), data = d, se_type = "HC2")
}

lin_comb <- function(m, w) {
  b <- coef(m); b <- b[!is.na(b)]
  V <- vcov(m)[names(b), names(b)]
  stopifnot(all(names(w) %in% names(b)))
  L <- setNames(numeric(length(b)), names(b)); L[names(w)] <- w
  est <- sum(L * b); se <- sqrt(drop(t(L) %*% V %*% L)); dfr <- unname(m$df[1])
  tibble(estimate = est, std.error = se,
         conf.low = est - qt(0.975, dfr) * se, conf.high = est + qt(0.975, dfr) * se,
         p.value = 2 * pt(abs(est / se), dfr, lower.tail = FALSE))
}

cname  <- function(ob, vig, cg = NULL) paste0("cell", if (!is.null(cg)) paste0(cg, "_"), ob, "_", vig)
w_cell <- function(vw, ob, cg = NULL) setNames(unname(vw), cname(ob, names(vw), cg))
w_all  <- function(vw) setNames(unname(vw), paste0("cell", names(vw)))

LV_OBS  <- "Observers"
LV_NON  <- "Non-observers"
LV_DIFF <- "Obs. - Non-obs."
LV_ALL  <- "All respondents"

run_contrasts <- function(m, by_cons = TRUE) {
  cg_levels <- if (by_cons) c("Hi", "Lo") else list(NULL)
  out <- list()
  add <- function(w, ...) out[[length(out) + 1]] <<- lin_comb(m, w) |> mutate(...)
  for (cn in names(VIG_CONTRASTS)) {
    vw <- VIG_CONTRASTS[[cn]]
    for (cg in cg_levels) {
      wo <- w_cell(vw, "Obs", cg); wn <- w_cell(vw, "Non", cg)
      grp <- if (is.null(cg)) "All" else cg
      add(wo,         contrast = cn, group = grp, level = LV_OBS)
      add(wn,         contrast = cn, group = grp, level = LV_NON)
      add(c(wo, -wn), contrast = cn, group = grp, level = LV_DIFF)
    }
    if (by_cons) {
      add(c(w_cell(vw, "Obs", "Hi"), -w_cell(vw, "Obs", "Lo")),
          contrast = cn, group = "Hi - Lo", level = LV_OBS)
      add(c(w_cell(vw, "Obs", "Hi"), -w_cell(vw, "Non", "Hi"),
            -w_cell(vw, "Obs", "Lo"),  w_cell(vw, "Non", "Lo")),
          contrast = cn, group = "Hi - Lo", level = LV_DIFF)
    }
  }
  bind_rows(out)
}

run_overall <- function(m) {
  bind_rows(lapply(names(VIG_CONTRASTS), function(cn)
    lin_comb(m, w_all(VIG_CONTRASTS[[cn]])) |>
      mutate(contrast = cn, group = "All", level = LV_ALL)))
}

assign_panel <- function(res) {
  res |>
    mutate(panel = case_when(
      group %in% c("Hi", "Lo") & level %in% c(LV_OBS, LV_NON) ~ "A",
      group %in% c("Hi", "Lo") & level == LV_DIFF             ~ "B",
      group == "Hi - Lo"       & level == LV_DIFF             ~ "C",
      group == "All"                                          ~ "D",
      TRUE                                                    ~ NA_character_))
}

## 7e. Estimate (all six measures, so the item-count robustness figure works)
res_all <- list()
for (mod_name in names(MODERATORS)) {
  d_mod <- add_cells(df_cit, MODERATORS[[mod_name]])
  for (VAR in c("Q119", "Q122")) {
    for (spec_name in names(SPECS)) {
      x <- SPECS[[spec_name]]$x; lin <- SPECS[[spec_name]]$lin
      if (!is.null(x)) x[x == "PRIOR"] <- MOD_CONT[[mod_name]]
      m12 <- fit_cells(VAR, d_mod, "cell12", x, lin)
      m6  <- fit_cells(VAR, d_mod, "cell6",  x, lin)
      m3  <- fit_cells(VAR, d_mod, "cell3",  x, lin)
      res_all[[length(res_all) + 1]] <- bind_rows(
        run_contrasts(m12, by_cons = TRUE)  |> mutate(n = m12$nobs),
        run_contrasts(m6,  by_cons = FALSE) |> mutate(n = m6$nobs),
        run_overall(m3)                     |> mutate(n = m3$nobs)
      ) |> mutate(moderator = mod_name, outcome = VAR, spec = spec_name)
    }
  }
}
res_all <- bind_rows(res_all) |>
  assign_panel() |>
  group_by(moderator, outcome, spec, panel) |>
  mutate(p.holm = ifelse(is.na(panel), NA_real_, p.adjust(p.value, method = "holm"))) |>
  ungroup()

## 7f. LaTeX tables
star_tex <- function(p) {
  s <- ifelse(p < 0.01, "***", ifelse(p < 0.05, "**", ifelse(p < 0.1, "*", "")))
  ifelse(s == "", "", paste0("$^{", s, "}$"))
}
tex_row <- function(label, vals) paste0(paste(c(label, vals), collapse = " & "), " \\\\")

MT_ROWS <- list(
  list(g = "Hi", l = LV_OBS,  lab = "Observers, high prior beliefs"),
  list(g = "Hi", l = LV_NON,  lab = "Non-observers, high prior beliefs"),
  list(g = "Hi", l = LV_DIFF, lab = "Difference between observers and non-observers: high prior beliefs"),
  list(g = "Lo", l = LV_OBS,  lab = "Observers, low prior beliefs"),
  list(g = "Lo", l = LV_NON,  lab = "Non-observers, low prior beliefs"),
  list(g = "Lo", l = LV_DIFF, lab = "Difference between observers and non-observers: low prior beliefs")
)

make_main_text_tex <- function(res, var, mod = "main", cn = CN_RC, spec = "No covariates") {
  d <- res |> filter(moderator == mod, outcome == var, contrast == cn, spec == !!spec)
  lines <- c(
    "\\begin{tblr}{colspec={X[l]rrcr}, width=\\linewidth, column{2-5}={halign=c}}",
    "\\toprule",
    "& Estimate & Std. error & 95\\% CI & $p$-value \\\\",
    "\\midrule")
  for (r in MT_ROWS) {
    x <- d |> filter(group == r$g, level == r$l)
    lines <- c(lines, tex_row(r$lab, c(
      paste0(sprintf("%.3f", x$estimate), star_tex(x$p.value)),
      sprintf("%.3f", x$std.error),
      sprintf("[%.3f, %.3f]", x$conf.low, x$conf.high),
      sprintf("%.3f", x$p.value))))
  }
  n <- d |> filter(group == "Hi", level == LV_OBS) |> pull(n)
  lines <- c(lines, "\\midrule", tex_row("N", c(as.character(n), "", "", "")),
             "\\bottomrule", "\\end{tblr}", "", "\\vspace{0.5em}", "",
             "\\begin{minipage}{\\linewidth}", "\\footnotesize",
             paste0("\\textit{Note:} Entries are differences in mean ", tolower(VAR_LABELS[[var]]),
                    " between the fraud + rebuttal article and the control article, from a ",
                    "saturated OLS model with one mean per prior belief $\\times$ observation ",
                    "$\\times$ article cell, without covariates. ", MOD_NOTE[[mod]],
                    " HC2 robust standard errors. $^{*}p<0.1$, $^{**}p<0.05$, $^{***}p<0.01$."),
             "\\end{minipage}")
  paste(lines, collapse = "\n")
}

SI_PANELS <- list(
  list(p = "A", lab = "Panel A. Effects within groups", rows = list(
    list(g = "Hi", l = LV_OBS, lab = "Observers, high prior beliefs"),

    list(g = "Hi - Lo", l = LV_DIFF, lab = "High minus low prior beliefs"))),

    list(g = "All", l = LV_DIFF, lab = "Difference (observers $-$ non-observers)")))
)

make_si_tex <- function(res, var, specs, measure_note = "") {
  d  <- res |> filter(outcome == var, spec %in% specs)
  S  <- length(specs); nc <- 1 + 3 * S
  cols <- expand.grid(contrast = names(VIG_CONTRASTS), spec = specs, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  get_vals <- function(g, l, what) {
    vapply(seq_len(nrow(cols)), function(j) {
      r <- d |> filter(group == g, level == l, contrast == cols$contrast[j], spec == cols$spec[j])
      if (nrow(r) != 1) return("")
      switch(what,
             est  = paste0(sprintf("%.3f", r$estimate), star_tex(r$p.value)),
             se   = sprintf("(%.3f)", r$std.error),
             holm = if (is.na(r$p.holm)) "" else sprintf("[%.3f]", r$p.holm),
             n    = as.character(r$n))
    }, character(1))
  }
  spec_hdr <- paste0("& ", paste0("\\SetCell[c=3]{c} ", specs, " & &", collapse = " & "), " \\\\")
  cmid <- paste(sprintf("\\cmidrule[lr]{%d-%d}", 2 + 3 * (0:(S - 1)), 4 + 3 * (0:(S - 1))), collapse = " ")
  lines <- c(
    paste0("\\begin{tblr}{colspec={X[l]", strrep("c", 3 * S), "}, width=\\linewidth, ",
           "rowsep=1pt, cells={font=\\footnotesize}, column{2-", nc, "}={halign=c}}"),
    "\\toprule", spec_hdr, cmid, tex_row("", rep(CONTRAST_TEX, S)), "\\midrule")
  for (p in SI_PANELS) {
    lines <- c(lines, paste0("\\SetCell[c=", nc, "]{l}\\textbf{", p$lab, "}", strrep(" &", nc - 1), " \\\\"))
    for (r in p$rows) {
      lines <- c(lines, tex_row(r$lab, get_vals(r$g, r$l, "est")),
                 tex_row("", get_vals(r$g, r$l, "se")),
                 tex_row("", get_vals(r$g, r$l, "holm")))
    }
  }
  lines <- c(lines, "\\midrule",
             tex_row("N (Panels A--C)", get_vals("Hi", LV_OBS, "n")),
             tex_row("N (Panel D)",     get_vals("All", LV_OBS, "n")),
             "\\bottomrule", "\\end{tblr}", "", "\\vspace{0.5em}", "",
             "\\begin{minipage}{\\linewidth}", "\\footnotesize",
             paste0("\\textit{Note:} ", measure_note, " Entries are differences in cell means from ",
                    "saturated OLS models with one mean per prior belief $\\times$ observation $\\times$ ",
                    "article cell (Panels A--C) or per observation $\\times$ article cell and per article ",
                    "(Panel D). Fraud: fraud-claims article; Fraud + Rebuttal: fraud claims with the ",
                    "official rebuttal; Control: no allegation. Panel C reports the triple difference: ",
                    "the observer--non-observer difference among high prior believers minus the same ",
                    "difference among low prior believers. Demographic controls: gender, age, marital ",
                    "status, and education (centered). Prior belief: the continuous version of the same ",
                    "measure (centered); Lin: covariates interacted with every cell (Lin 2013). ",
                    "HC2 robust standard errors in parentheses. ",
                    "Holm-adjusted $p$-values in brackets, adjusting across all rows and comparisons ",
                    "within each panel and specification. $^{*}p<0.1$, $^{**}p<0.05$, $^{***}p<0.01$ (unadjusted)."),
             "\\end{minipage}")
  paste(lines, collapse = "\n")
}

## Key-estimates table (first page and each robustness section)
KEY_ROWS <- list(
  list(panel = "Panel A. Allegation + rebuttal vs. control (focal question)"),
  list(cn = CN_RC, g = "Hi", l = LV_OBS,  lab = "$\\tau_{2C}(1,1)$: observers, high belief"),
  list(cn = CN_RC, g = "Hi", l = LV_NON,  lab = "$\\tau_{2C}(0,1)$: non-observers, high belief"),
  list(cn = CN_RC, g = "Hi", l = LV_DIFF, lab = "$\\Delta_{2C}(1)$: obs. $-$ non-obs., high belief"),
  list(cn = CN_RC, g = "Lo", l = LV_DIFF, lab = "$\\Delta_{2C}(0)$: obs. $-$ non-obs., low belief"),
  list(cn = CN_RC, g = "Hi - Lo", l = LV_DIFF, lab = "$\\Omega_{2C} = \\delta_2$: high $-$ low"),
  list(panel = "Panel B. Rebuttal vs. fraud (separate question)"),
  list(cn = CN_RF, g = "Hi", l = LV_DIFF, lab = "$\\Delta_{21}(1)$: obs. $-$ non-obs., high belief"),
  list(cn = CN_RF, g = "Lo", l = LV_DIFF, lab = "$\\Delta_{21}(0)$: obs. $-$ non-obs., low belief"),
  list(cn = CN_RF, g = "Hi - Lo", l = LV_DIFF, lab = "$\\Omega_{21} = \\delta_2 - \\delta_1$: high $-$ low")
)
KEY_HDR <- c("{No\\\\covariates}", "{Demographic\\\\controls}",
             "{Demographic +\\\\prior belief}", "{Demographic +\\\\prior belief (Lin)}")

make_key_tex <- function(mod = "main", var = "Q119") {
  d <- res_all |> filter(moderator == mod, outcome == var)
  specs <- names(SPECS)
  cell <- function(r, what) vapply(specs, function(s) {
    x <- d |> filter(contrast == r$cn, group == r$g, level == r$l, spec == s)
    if (nrow(x) != 1) return("")
    if (what == "est") paste0(sprintf("%.3f", x$estimate), star_tex(x$p.value))
    else sprintf("(%.3f)", x$std.error)
  }, character(1))
  lines <- c("\\begin{tblr}{colspec={X[l]cccc}, width=\\linewidth, rowsep=1pt, cells={font=\\footnotesize}, column{2-5}={halign=c}}",
             "\\toprule", tex_row("", KEY_HDR), "\\midrule")
  for (r in KEY_ROWS) {
    if (!is.null(r$panel)) {
      lines <- c(lines, paste0("\\SetCell[c=5]{l}\\textbf{", r$panel, "} & & & & \\\\"))
    } else {
      lines <- c(lines, tex_row(r$lab, cell(r, "est")), tex_row("", cell(r, "se")))
    }
  }
  n <- d |> filter(contrast == CN_RC, group == "Hi", level == LV_OBS) |>
    arrange(match(spec, specs)) |> pull(n)
  lines <- c(lines, "\\midrule", tex_row("N", as.character(n)), "\\bottomrule", "\\end{tblr}",
             "", "\\vspace{0.5em}", "", "\\begin{minipage}{\\linewidth}", "\\footnotesize",
             paste0("\\textit{Note:} Outcome: ", tolower(VAR_LABELS[[var]]), " (", var,
                    ", five-point scale). ", MOD_NOTE[[mod]],
                    " Entries are linear combinations of cell means from the saturated model ",
                    "(equivalent to the fully interacted model in the Empirical Strategy). ",
                    "$\\tau$: effect within a group; $\\Delta$: observers minus non-observers; ",
                    "$\\Omega$: $\\Delta$ for high minus $\\Delta$ for low prior belief. ",
                    "Columns 3--4 add the continuous version of the same prior-belief measure ",
                    "(additively, or interacted with every cell as in Lin 2013). ",
                    "HC2 robust standard errors in parentheses. ",
                    "$^{*}p<0.1$, $^{**}p<0.05$, $^{***}p<0.01$ (unadjusted)."),
             "\\end{minipage}")
  paste(lines, collapse = "\n")
}

## 7g. Contrast figures
fig_theme <- theme_classic(base_size = 15) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))

prep_fig <- function(d, specs) {
  d |> filter(spec %in% specs) |>
    mutate(contrast = factor(contrast, levels = names(VIG_CONTRASTS)),
           spec     = factor(spec, levels = specs))
}

plot_overall <- function(res, var, specs, by_obs = FALSE) {
  d <- res |>
    filter(outcome == var, group == "All",
           level %in% (if (by_obs) c(LV_OBS, LV_NON) else LV_ALL)) |>
    prep_fig(specs) |>
    mutate(level = factor(level, levels = c(LV_ALL, LV_OBS, LV_NON)))
  p <- ggplot(d, aes(x = estimate, y = spec, color = spec, xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high)) +
    geom_pointrange(size = 0.5) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
    scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(specs)) +
    labs(x = "Difference in means (5-point scale)", y = NULL, color = "Model",
         caption = str_wrap(out_caption(var), width = 90)) +
    fig_theme + theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank())
  if (by_obs) p + facet_grid(level ~ contrast) else p + facet_wrap(~ contrast, nrow = 1)
}

plot_contrasts <- function(res, var, specs, lo_lab = "Low prior belief", hi_lab = "High prior belief") {
  d <- res |>
    filter(outcome == var, group %in% c("Hi", "Lo"), level %in% c(LV_OBS, LV_NON)) |>
    prep_fig(specs) |>
    mutate(group = factor(group, levels = c("Lo", "Hi"), labels = c(lo_lab, hi_lab)),
           level = factor(level, levels = c(LV_OBS, LV_NON)))
  ggplot(d, aes(x = estimate, y = group, color = spec, xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high)) +
    geom_pointrange(position = position_dodge(width = -0.5), size = 0.5) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
    facet_grid(level ~ contrast) +
    labs(x = "Difference in means (5-point scale)", y = NULL, color = "Model",
         caption = str_wrap(out_caption(var), width = 90)) +
    fig_theme
}

## 7h. Robustness: other moderators, and the prior-belief split standardized
## to party and fairness composition (now for each reported measure)
ALT_MODS <- list(

```{r interflex_run, include = FALSE}
# =============================================================================
# 8. CONTINUOUS MODERATOR: INTERFLEX (production Section 8), for each measure
# =============================================================================
IF_SPECS <- setNames(COV_SETS, COV_LAB[names(COV_SETS)])
IF_JOBS  <- list(
  list(base = "C", keep = c(F = CN_FC, R = CN_RC)),
  list(base = "F", keep = c(R = CN_RF))
)
if_bins <- function(mod) list(
  terciles = list(nbins = 3, cutoffs = NULL),
  median   = list(nbins = 2, cutoffs = CONSP_MED[[mod]])
)

if_data <- function(var, obs_lv, z, xvar) {
  df_cit |>
    filter(obs == obs_lv) |>
    mutate(vig_chr = as.character(vig)) |>
    select(all_of(c(var, "vig_chr", xvar, z))) |>
    mutate(across(-vig_chr, ~ as.numeric(.x))) |>
    as.data.frame() |>
    na.omit()
}

run_if <- function(var, obs_lv, z, base, bins, xvar) {
  interflex(
    estimator = "binning", data = if_data(var, obs_lv, z, xvar),
    Y = var, D = "vig_chr", X = xvar, Z = z,
    treat.type = "discrete", base = base,
    nbins = bins$nbins, cutoffs = bins$cutoffs,
    vartype = "delta", vcov.type = "robust",
    wald = TRUE, parallel = FALSE, figure = TRUE, Xdistr = "histogram",
    Xlabel = "Prior conspiracy belief", Ylabel = out_label(var), Dlabel = "Vignette")
}

pull_est <- function(lst, arms) {
  lapply(arms, function(tr) {
    e <- as.data.frame(lst[[tr]])[, 1:5]
    names(e) <- c("x", "estimate", "std.error", "conf.low", "conf.high")
    e$treat <- tr
    e
  }) |> bind_rows()
}
num1 <- function(x) { x <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x)); if (length(x) == 0) NA_real_ else x[1] }

if_lin <- list(); if_bin <- list(); if_wald <- list(); if_fail <- character(0)
for (mod in names(REPORT_MODS)) {
  xvar <- CONSP_CONT[[mod]]; BINS <- if_bins(mod)
  for (spec_name in names(IF_SPECS)) {
    for (VAR in c("Q119", "Q122")) {
      for (bin_name in names(BINS)) {
        for (pp in c("Obs", "Non")) {
          for (job in IF_JOBS) {
            out <- NULL
            invisible(capture.output(
              out <- tryCatch(
                run_if(VAR, pp, IF_SPECS[[spec_name]], job$base, BINS[[bin_name]], xvar),
                error = function(e) {
                  if_fail <<- c(if_fail, paste(mod, VAR, spec_name, bin_name, pp, job$base,
                                               conditionMessage(e), sep = " | "))
                  NULL
                })
            ))
            if (is.null(out)) next
            arms <- names(job$keep)
            tag  <- function(d) d |>
              mutate(contrast = unname(job$keep[treat]), outcome = VAR, spec = spec_name,
                     bins = bin_name, obs = pp, mod = mod)
            if (bin_name == "terciles" || is.null(out$est.lin) == FALSE &&
                !any(sapply(if_lin, function(z) any(z$mod == mod & z$outcome == VAR &
                       z$spec == spec_name & z$obs == pp & z$treat %in% arms)))) {
              if_lin[[length(if_lin) + 1]] <- tag(pull_est(out$est.lin, arms))
            }
            if_bin[[length(if_bin) + 1]] <- tag(pull_est(out$est.bin, arms))
            for (tr in arms) {
              if_wald[[length(if_wald) + 1]] <- tibble(
                mod = mod, outcome = VAR, spec = spec_name, bins = bin_name, obs = pp,
                contrast = unname(job$keep[tr]),
                p_wald_arm   = num1(out$tests$sub.test[[tr]]$p.wald),
                p_wald_joint = num1(out$tests$p.wald),
                n = nrow(if_data(VAR, pp, IF_SPECS[[spec_name]], xvar)))
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
if_lin  <- bind_rows(if_lin)
if_bin  <- bind_rows(if_bin)
if_wald <- bind_rows(if_wald)

## Combined figure: linear estimator (line), binned estimates (points),
## and the moderator distribution of the two articles compared (bottom)
HIST_BREAKS <- seq(1, 4, by = 0.125)
HIST_SHARE  <- 0.25

hist_data <- function(var, spec_name, mod) {
  xvar <- CONSP_CONT[[mod]]; out <- list()
  for (pp in c("Obs", "Non")) {
    d <- if_data(var, pp, IF_SPECS[[spec_name]], xvar)
    for (cn in names(VIG_CONTRASTS)) {
      vw   <- VIG_CONTRASTS[[cn]]
      arms <- c(ref = names(vw)[vw < 0], cmp = names(vw)[vw > 0])
      for (a in names(arms)) {
        x   <- d[[xvar]][d$vig_chr == arms[[a]]]
        bin <- cut(x, HIST_BREAKS, include.lowest = TRUE, labels = FALSE)
        out[[length(out) + 1]] <- tibble(
          obs = pp, contrast = cn, arm = a,
          xmin = head(HIST_BREAKS, -1), xmax = tail(HIST_BREAKS, -1),
          count = tabulate(bin, nbins = length(HIST_BREAKS) - 1))
      }
    }
  }
  bind_rows(out)
}

plot_if <- function(var, spec_name, bin_name, mod = "main") {
  fix <- function(d) d |>
    mutate(obs = factor(obs, levels = c("Obs", "Non"), labels = c("Observers", "Non-observers")),
           contrast = factor(contrast, levels = names(VIG_CONTRASTS)))
  L <- if_lin |> filter(mod == !!mod, outcome == var, spec == spec_name) |> fix()
  B <- if_bin |> filter(mod == !!mod, outcome == var, spec == spec_name, bins == bin_name) |> fix()
  if (nrow(B) == 0) stop("no binned estimates for this specification")
  yr   <- range(c(L$conf.low, L$conf.high, B$conf.low, B$conf.high, 0), na.rm = TRUE)
  span <- diff(yr); hgt <- HIST_SHARE * span; y0 <- yr[1] - hgt - 0.05 * span
  H <- hist_data(var, spec_name, mod) |>
    group_by(obs, contrast, xmin) |>
    mutate(ref_n = sum(count[arm == "ref"])) |>
    ungroup() |>
    mutate(lo = ifelse(arm == "ref", 0, ref_n), hi = lo + count)
  max_tot <- max(H$hi)
  H <- H |> filter(count > 0) |>
    mutate(ymin = y0 + hgt * lo / max_tot, ymax = y0 + hgt * hi / max_tot) |> fix()
  ggplot() +
    geom_rect(data = H, aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax, fill = arm),
              color = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(ref = "gray80", cmp = "gray45"), breaks = c("ref", "cmp"),
                      labels = c(ref = "Reference vignette", cmp = "Compared vignette"),
                      name = "Moderator distribution") +
    geom_ribbon(data = L, aes(x = x, ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high), fill = "gray70", alpha = 0.4) +
    geom_line(data = L, aes(x = x, y = estimate), linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_pointrange(data = B, aes(x = x, y = estimate, ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high),
                    color = "#C00000", size = 0.5) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = CONSP_MED[[mod]], linetype = "dotted") +
    facet_grid(obs ~ contrast) +
    labs(x = paste0("Prior conspiracy belief: ", REPORT_MODS[[mod]],
                    " (1-4; dotted line = citizen median)"),
         y = "Conditional effect", title = paste0(spec_name, " | bins: ", bin_name),
         caption = str_wrap(paste0(
           "Line and band: linear interaction estimator with 95% CI. ",
           "Points: binning estimator at bin medians. ",
           "Bottom: distribution of the moderator in the two vignette groups ",
           "being compared (stacked). ", out_caption(var)), width = 100)) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
    theme(strip.background = element_blank(), strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
          plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"), legend.position = "bottom")
}

wald_tex <- function(mod, bn) {
  d <- if_wald |> filter(mod == !!mod, bins == bn) |>
    mutate(obs = ifelse(obs == "Obs", "Observers", "Non-observers"),
           p_wald_arm = fmt_pval(p_wald_arm), p_wald_joint = fmt_pval(p_wald_joint)) |>
    select(Outcome = outcome, Specification = spec, Group = obs,
           Comparison = contrast, `Wald p (arm)` = p_wald_arm,
           `Wald p (joint)` = p_wald_joint, N = n)
  knitr::kable(d, format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, linesep = "")
}

## 8c. Diagnostic: interflex binned estimates vs. differences in means (main)
chk_bin <- function(var, obs_lv, hi, arms) {
  d      <- if_data(var, obs_lv, NULL, "conspiracy_belief")
  in_bin <- if (hi) d$conspiracy_belief > med_6 else d$conspiracy_belief <= med_6
  x0     <- median(d$conspiracy_belief[in_bin])
  b      <- d[in_bin & d$vig_chr %in% arms, ]
  b$D    <- as.integer(b$vig_chr == arms[[1]])
  b$Xc   <- b$conspiracy_belief - x0
  m      <- lm(as.formula(paste(var, "~ D * Xc")), data = b)
  tibble(outcome = var, obs = obs_lv, group = if (hi) "Hi" else "Lo",
         contrast = names(VIG_CONTRASTS)[sapply(VIG_CONTRASTS, function(v)
           identical(names(v)[v > 0], arms[[1]]) && identical(names(v)[v < 0], arms[[2]]))],
         diff_in_means = mean(b[[var]][b$D == 1]) - mean(b[[var]][b$D == 0]),
         local_linear_at_x0 = unname(coef(m)["D"]))
}
diag_tbl <- bind_rows(lapply(c("Q119", "Q122"), function(VAR)
  bind_rows(lapply(c("Obs", "Non"), function(pp)
    bind_rows(lapply(c(TRUE, FALSE), function(hi)
      bind_rows(lapply(list(c("F", "C"), c("R", "C"), c("R", "F")), function(a)
        chk_bin(VAR, pp, hi, a)))))))))
s7 <- res_all |>
  filter(moderator == "main", spec == "No covariates", group %in% c("Hi", "Lo"),
         level %in% c(LV_OBS, LV_NON)) |>
  mutate(obs = ifelse(level == LV_OBS, "Obs", "Non")) |>
  select(outcome, obs, group, contrast, section7 = estimate)
ifx <- if_bin |>
  filter(mod == "main", spec == "No covariates", bins == "median") |>
  mutate(group = ifelse(x > med_6, "Hi", "Lo")) |>
  select(outcome, obs, group, contrast, interflex = estimate)
compare_tbl <- diag_tbl |>
  left_join(s7,  by = c("outcome", "obs", "group", "contrast")) |>
  left_join(ifx, by = c("outcome", "obs", "group", "contrast")) |>
  select(outcome, obs, group, contrast, diff_in_means, section7, local_linear_at_x0, interflex) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 3)))

## Full repeat of the measure-specific tables and figures for one measure
report_measure <- function(mod) {
  nm  <- REPORT_MODS[[mod]]
  mi  <- meas_tbl |> filter(mod == !!mod)
  kf  <- est_row(mod = mod)
  kfp <- est_row(mod = mod, spec = "Demographic + prior belief")
  kom <- est_row(mod = mod, g = "Hi - Lo")
  krf <- est_row(mod = mod, cn = CN_RF)
  ks  <- est_row(mod = paste0("prior_std_", mod), spec = "Standardized: party + fairness", res = res_other)

  emit_md("This section repeats every measure-specific table and figure with the ", nm, " (",
          gsub("_", "\\\\_", mi$Items), "). The citizen-sample median is ", sprintf("%.3f", mi$Cutoff),
          "; ", sprintf("%.1f", 100 * mi$`Share above median`), "\\% of citizens are above it, and ",
          sprintf("%.1f", 100 * mi$`Same group as 6-item split`),
          "\\% fall in the same group as under the 6-item split. Tables and figures that do not depend ",
          "on the prior-belief measure (summary statistics, balance, pooled effects, party and fairness ",
          "splits) are in Sections 2 and 3.")
  emit_md("*Summary.* For Q119, $\\Delta_{2C}(1)$ is ", fe_ci(kf), " without covariates and ",
          fe(kfp), " after adding the continuous ", nm, ". $\\Omega_{2C}$ is ", fe(kom),
          ". For rebuttal versus fraud, $\\Delta_{21}(1)$ is ", fe(krf),
          ". Standardized to party and fairness composition, $\\Delta_{2C}(1)$ is ", fe(ks), ".")

  emit_md("## Key estimates")
  emit_tbl(make_key_tex(mod, "Q119"), paste0("Key estimates: ", nm, ", Q119"))
  emit_tbl(make_key_tex(mod, "Q122"), paste0("Key estimates: ", nm, ", Q122"))

  emit_md("## Raw means by observation status and prior belief")
  for (v in c("Q119", "Q122")) {
    emit_fig(cibar_by_belief(v, mod), paste0("Mean ", out_short(v),
             " by article, observation status, and prior belief (", nm, ")"), w = 10, h = 8)
  }

  emit_md("## Focal contrast: allegation plus rebuttal vs. control")
  for (v in c("Q119", "Q122")) {
    emit_tbl(make_main_text_tex(res_all, v, mod),
             paste0("Effect of the allegation-plus-rebuttal article relative to control on ",
                    out_short(v), " (", nm, ")"))
  }

  emit_md("## All contrasts by observation status and prior belief")
  for (v in c("Q119", "Q122")) {
    emit_tbl(make_si_tex(res_all |> filter(moderator == mod), v, SPEC_SETS$main, MOD_NOTE[[mod]]),
             paste0("All article contrasts for ", out_short(v), ": no covariates and demographic controls (", nm, ")"), fit = TRUE)
    emit_fig(plot_contrasts(res_all |> filter(moderator == mod), v, SPEC_SETS$main),
             paste0("Article contrasts for ", out_short(v), " by observation status and prior belief (", nm, ")"),
             w = 12, h = 7)
  }

  emit_md("## Three-way interaction regression")
  emit_tbl(tbl_threeway(mod), paste0("Three-way interaction model (", nm, ")"), small = TRUE, fit = TRUE)

  emit_md("## Adjusting for continuous prior beliefs")
  for (v in c("Q119", "Q122")) {
    emit_tbl(make_si_tex(res_all |> filter(moderator == mod), v, SPEC_SETS$appx, MOD_NOTE[[mod]]),
             paste0("All article contrasts for ", out_short(v), ": adding the continuous ", nm), fit = TRUE)
    emit_fig(plot_contrasts(res_all |> filter(moderator == mod), v, SPEC_SETS$appx),
             paste0("Article contrasts for ", out_short(v), ", adding the continuous ", nm), w = 12, h = 7)
  }

  emit_md("## Balance of prior beliefs within groups")
  emit_tbl(make_balance_prior_tex(mod),
           paste0("Continuous ", nm, " by observation status, prior-belief group, and article"))

  emit_md("## Continuous moderator (interflex)")
  for (bn in c("median", "terciles")) {
    for (sp in names(IF_SPECS)) {
      for (v in c("Q119", "Q122")) {
        safely(emit_fig(plot_if(v, sp, bn, mod),
                        paste0("Conditional effects on ", out_short(v), " over the continuous ", nm,
                               " (", tolower(sp), "; ", bn, " bins)"), w = 12, h = 8),
               paste("interflex figure", v, sp, bn))
      }
    }
  }
  for (bn in c("median", "terciles")) {
    safely(emit_tbl(wald_tex(mod, bn), paste0("Wald tests of the linear interaction model (", nm, "; ",
                                              bn, " bins)"), small = TRUE, fit = TRUE),
           "Wald table")
  }

  emit_md("## Subgroup regression tables by prior belief")
  for (v in c("Q119", "Q122")) {
    emit_tbl(tbl_by_belief(v, mod),
             paste0("Effects on ", out_short(v), " within prior-belief groups (", nm, ")"), small = TRUE, fit = TRUE)
  }

  emit_md("## Standardized to party and fairness composition")
  for (v in c("Q119", "Q122")) {
    emit_fig(plot_contrasts(res_other |> filter(moderator == paste0("prior_std_", mod)), v, names(STD_SPECS)),
             paste0("Article contrasts for ", out_short(v), " by prior belief (", nm,
                    "), standardized to party and fairness composition"), w = 12, h = 7)
  }
}
```

est_row <- function(mod = "main", var = "Q119", spec = "No covariates",
                    cn = CN_RC, g = "Hi", l = LV_DIFF, res = res_all) {
  r <- res |> filter(moderator == mod, outcome == var, .data$spec == .env$spec,
                     contrast == cn, group == g, level == l)
  stopifnot(nrow(r) == 1)
  r
}
num   <- function(x, d = 2) paste0("$", sprintf(paste0("%.", d, "f"), x), "$")
p_txt <- function(p) if (p < 0.001) "$p < 0.001$" else paste0("$p = ", sprintf("%.3f", p), "$")
ci_txt <- function(r) sprintf("$[%.2f, %.2f]$", r$conf.low, r$conf.high)
fe    <- function(r) paste0(num(r$estimate), " (SE ", sprintf("%.2f", r$std.error), ", ", p_txt(r$p.value), ")")
fe_ci <- function(r) paste0(num(r$estimate), " (95\\% CI ", ci_txt(r), "; ", p_txt(r$p.value), ")")
dirw  <- function(x, neg = "lower", pos = "higher") if (x < 0) neg else pos

## Key numbers (6-item index, Q119)

k_focal_d <- est_row(spec = "Demographic controls")
k_focal_p <- est_row(spec = "Demographic + prior belief")
k_focal_l <- est_row(spec = "Demographic + prior belief (Lin)")
k_low     <- est_row(g = "Lo")
k_omega   <- est_row(g = "Hi - Lo")

k_non_hi  <- est_row(l = LV_NON)
k_rf      <- est_row(cn = CN_RF)

## Measure descriptives

  Cutoff = unname(CONSP_MED[names(REPORT_MODS)]),
  `Share above median` = sapply(names(REPORT_MODS), function(k) mean(df_cit[[CONSP_HIGH[[k]]]], na.rm = TRUE)),
  `N (valid)` = sapply(names(REPORT_MODS), function(k) sum(!is.na(df_cit[[CONSP_HIGH[[k]]]]))),
  `Same group as 6-item split` = sapply(names(REPORT_MODS), function(k)
    mean(df_cit[[CONSP_HIGH[[k]]]] == df_cit$conspiracy_high, na.rm = TRUE))
)

\thispagestyle{empty}

# Key Takeaway {-}

**Research question.** Does firsthand observation change how citizens respond to competing claims about electoral integrity?

**In one sentence.** Exploratory evidence suggests that firsthand observation shifts how citizens with stronger prior conspiracy beliefs respond to a news report pairing a fraud allegation with an official rebuttal, toward lower perceived fraud or procedural problems.

**In one paragraph.** Among citizens with above-median prior conspiracy beliefs, the effect of an allegation-plus-rebuttal article relative to an incident-only control is `r sprintf("%.2f", abs(k_focal$estimate))` points `r dirw(k_focal$estimate, "more negative", "more positive")` among observers than non-observers on a five-point scale (95\% CI `r ci_txt(k_focal)`; `r p_txt(k_focal$p.value)`). This suggests that firsthand institutional experience may shape how suspicious citizens interpret competing claims about electoral integrity. However, the contrast weakens after adjustment for continuous prior beliefs (`r fe(k_focal_p)`), and the incremental effect of adding the rebuttal alone remains uncertain (`r fe(k_rf)`). We therefore interpret the finding as exploratory evidence of an observation-conditioned response to competing claims.

**Two questions we should keep apart.**

(a) *Our focal question:* Does observation change the effect of encountering an allegation paired with an official response? This compares the allegation-plus-rebuttal article with the control article. The estimand is $\Delta_{2C}(b)$, and the test of whether it differs by prior belief is $\Omega_{2C} = \delta_2$. This is where the evidence is.

(b) *A separate question:* Does observation make adding the official response more effective? This compares the allegation-plus-rebuttal article with the allegation-only article. The estimand is $\Delta_{21}(b)$, and $\Omega_{21} = \delta_2 - \delta_1$. The evidence here is weak, so we should not claim that observers respond more to the rebuttal itself.

Table \ref{tab:key} summarizes these estimates across the four specifications. Section 1 gives the full empirical strategy.

```{r key_table, results = "asis"}
emit_tbl(make_key_tex("main", "Q119"),
         "Key estimates at a glance: 6-item index, perceived fraud or procedural problems (Q119)\\label{tab:key}")
```

\newpage

# Empirical Strategy

Our primary outcome, $Y_i$, measures the perceived likelihood that the vignette incident reflects election fraud or a serious procedural problem on a five-point scale. We estimate the following fully interacted ordinary least squares model:

\begin{equation}
\begin{aligned}
Y_i ={}& \alpha
+ \beta_1 T_{1i}
+ \beta_2 T_{2i}
+ \beta_D D_i
+ \beta_B B_i \\
&+ \gamma_1 T_{1i}D_i
+ \gamma_2 T_{2i}D_i \\
&+ \gamma_3 T_{1i}B_i
+ \gamma_4 T_{2i}B_i
+ \gamma_5 D_iB_i \\
&+ \delta_1 T_{1i}D_iB_i
+ \delta_2 T_{2i}D_iB_i
+ \varepsilon_i.
\end{aligned}
\end{equation}

Here, $T_{1i}$ indicates assignment to the fraud-allegation article, and $T_{2i}$ indicates assignment to the allegation-plus-rebuttal article. The control article is the reference condition. $D_i$ indicates participation as a citizen observer, and $B_i$ indicates a pretreatment conspiracy-belief index above the citizen-sample median. Respondents at or below the median constitute the low-belief group.

The model estimates separate means for all 12 combinations of article assignment, observation status, and prior-belief group. Within each observation and prior-belief group, we calculate three contrasts:

\begin{align}
\tau_{1C}(d,b) &= \beta_1 + \gamma_1 d + \gamma_3 b + \delta_1 db, \\
\tau_{2C}(d,b) &= \beta_2 + \gamma_2 d + \gamma_4 b + \delta_2 db, \\
\tau_{21}(d,b) &= \tau_{2C}(d,b) - \tau_{1C}(d,b),
\end{align}

where $d\in\{0,1\}$ denotes non-observers and observers, respectively, and $b\in\{0,1\}$ denotes respondents with low and high prior conspiracy beliefs, respectively. The subscripts identify the article comparisons, with $C$ denoting control. The first contrast captures the effect of adding the fraud allegation relative to control. The second captures the combined effect of the allegation and official rebuttal relative to control. The third isolates the incremental effect of adding the official rebuttal to the allegation. These contrasts equal the corresponding differences in sample means.

We assess heterogeneity by directly comparing treatment contrasts. Let $k\in\{1C,2C,21\}$ index the three article comparisons: treatment 1 (fraud allegation) versus control, treatment 2 (allegation plus rebuttal) versus control, and treatment 2 versus treatment 1, respectively. Each contrast subtracts the mean in the second condition from the mean in the first; the final comparison isolates the incremental effect of the official rebuttal. For each comparison, the difference in treatment effects between observers and non-observers within prior-belief group $b$ is:

\begin{equation}
\Delta_k(b) = \tau_k(1,b) - \tau_k(0,b).
\end{equation}

We then test whether this difference varies between high- and low-belief respondents:

\begin{equation}
\Omega_k = \Delta_k(1) - \Delta_k(0).
\end{equation}

The corresponding three-way contrasts are $\delta_1$, $\delta_2$, and $\delta_2-\delta_1$ for fraud versus control, allegation plus rebuttal versus control, and rebuttal versus fraud, respectively. We also compare high- and low-belief respondents within each observation group. We calculate robust standard errors and report two-sided tests and 95\% confidence intervals.

Finally, we examine the continuous pretreatment belief index using the binning estimator implemented in \texttt{interflex} (Hainmueller, Mummolo, and Xu 2019). For each pairwise article comparison, we estimate effects separately among observers and non-observers using bins defined by the median. We display the index distributions across article conditions to assess common support. Because the subgroup pattern was identified post hoc and was not preregistered, we interpret the findings as exploratory.

## How the tables map to the notation

- "Effects within groups" (Panel A of the contrast tables) are $\tau_k(d,b)$.
- "Differences between observers and non-observers" (Panel B) are $\Delta_k(b)$.
- "High minus low prior beliefs" (Panel C) is $\Omega_k$. For allegation plus rebuttal versus control, it equals $\delta_2$ in the three-way interaction table.
- All contrasts come from a saturated model with one mean per cell. HC2 robust standard errors. Brackets show Holm-adjusted $p$-values within each panel.
- Specifications: no covariates; demographic controls (gender, age, marital status, education); demographic controls plus the continuous version of the same prior-belief measure, added either additively or interacted with every cell (Lin 2013).

## Prior-belief measures

All measures average recoded Q18 items (1--4, higher = stronger conspiracy belief) and split the citizen sample at its median (high = above the median). The 6-item index is the main measure. Sections 4 and 5 repeat every measure-specific table and figure with the 3-item average of the conspiracy-worded items and with the single China item.

  "\\midrule",
  sprintf("%s & %s & %.3f & %.3f & %d & %.3f \\\\", meas_tbl$Measure, gsub("_", "\\\\_", meas_tbl$Items),
          meas_tbl$Cutoff, meas_tbl$`Share above median`, as.integer(meas_tbl$`N (valid)`),
          meas_tbl$`Same group as 6-item split`),
